any2md.pain1: No more pip-installing four tools or fighting Python environments
any2md.pain2: Convert PDFs to structured Markdown before feeding LLMs — token costs can drop by orders of magnitude
any2md.pain3: Word/Excel tables survive intact, with merged cells handled correctly
any2md.pain4: PPT content is no longer ignored — slides and notes are fully extracted
any2md.faq1.a: Word (doc/docx), PowerPoint (ppt/pptx), Excel (xls/xlsx), OpenDocument (odt/ods/odp), RTF, EPUB, CSV and PDF — 13 in total. Format is auto-detected from content, so even a wrong extension converts correctly.
any2md.faq2.q: Are my files uploaded to a server?
any2md.faq2.a: No. Conversion runs entirely in your browser; files never leave your device. The only network request is the first-time download of the WASM engine (~3MB, cached afterwards).
any2md.faq3.a: No. This tool does text extraction, not OCR. Image-only scanned PDFs without a text layer will fail.
any2md.faq4.q: How do I get the result out?
any2md.faq4.a: Three ways: download the .md file, copy the full text, or click “Continue to MD to HTML” to bring it into 100mini's template system and publish a web page.
any2md.faq5.q: Is there a file size limit?
any2md.faq5.a: 20MB per file. Very large or long documents will convert noticeably slower, since the browser is single-threaded.
any2md.faq6.q: Are Excel formulas and PPT animations preserved?
any2md.faq6.a: Excel exports computed values, not formulas. PPT extracts text only — animations, videos and transitions are dropped.

idphoto.pain: Pain points: have you hit these problems making ID photos?
idphoto.pain.desc1: Many apps let you edit for free, then demand $5–17 on export or push weekly subscriptions. Free is just bait.
idphoto.pain.hd2: Face photos uploaded to the cloud
idphoto.pain.desc2: Sending biometric photos to unknown servers — who guarantees they won't be misused? This is the #1 trust concern.
idphoto.pain.desc3: Rejections are rarely about pixel size — it's head-to-body ratio, background shadows, glasses, expression, and lighting. Competitors charge $9–17 for this.
idphoto.pain.desc4: DS-160 requires <240KB, India often limits to 20–50KB. Free tools export files that are too big, silently rejected by the system.
idphoto.pain.desc5: Applying for US/Schengen/Japan visas? You can't find the right sizes and background specs anywhere — offline photo studios charge a premium.

idphoto.faq1.q: Is it really 100% free? Will export ask for money?
idphoto.faq1.a: Yes — permanently free, no watermark, no subscription. All features are available immediately. Export downloads directly, no paywall.
idphoto.faq2.q: Are my photos safe? Will they be uploaded?
idphoto.faq2.a: No. The tool runs 100% in your browser. Face photos never leave your device — close the page and all temporary data is cleared.
idphoto.faq3.q: Why do my ID photos keep getting rejected?
idphoto.faq3.a: Rejections are almost never about pixel size — they're about head ratio, background, glasses, lighting, or expression. We have built-in compliance checking with real-time display.
idphoto.faq4.q: Which countries and visa specs are supported?
idphoto.faq4.a: First batch covers US, Canada, UK, Schengen (EU), India, Japan, Korea, Australia, Brazil, plus common Chinese ID specs.
idphoto.faq5.q: Digital submissions have file size limits — can you control that?
idphoto.faq5.a: Yes. Export has digital submission presets: DS-160 (<240KB), US renewal (<5MB), UK (<10MB), Japan Myna (<600KB), India (≤30KB), Canada.
idphoto.faq6.q: Can I use AI background swap for a US passport photo?
idphoto.faq6.a: US digital passport submissions do not allow background changes — the tool shows a warning. Other countries support background swap normally.
idphoto.faq7.q: Do I need internet? Can I use it on my phone?
idphoto.faq7.a: First run requires internet to download the AI model; after that, processing is local. Responsive design works on mobile and desktop.
idphoto.faq8.q: Can I print the photos directly?
idphoto.faq8.a: Yes. Switch to Print Layout tab, choose 4R/A6/A5/A4, and multiple photos are laid out per sheet — ready for any print shop.
idphoto.faq9.q: How does it compare to paid apps?
idphoto.faq9.a: They charge for compliance, international specs, and watermark removal. We make all that free and local.

petsafe.guide.step3.item1: Register microchip ID at local animal shelters, rescue centers, and 5 nearby pet hospitals.
petsafe.guide.step3.item2: Place owner's strongly-scented old clothes and food bowl at the original lost point (scent lighthouse).

pomodoro.faq1.a: The Pomodoro Technique is a time management method that breaks work into 25-minute focus sessions separated by short breaks. After every 4 focus sessions, take a longer break to maintain productivity.
pomodoro.faq2.q: How long is a Pomodoro session?

pomodoro.faq3.q: How many Pomodoros should I do per day?
pomodoro.faq3.a: It varies by individual. Beginners can start with 4-6 Pomodoros per day, while experienced users typically complete 8-12. The key is maintaining a sustainable rhythm rather than chasing a specific number.
